sed 's#/tmp/stress.py#/workspace/tmp/stress.py#; s#/tmp/program.json#/workspace/tmp/program.json#' /dev/null >/dev/null
cat > /workspace/tmp/stress.py <<'PY'
import json,sys,time,subprocess
N=int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv)>1 else 100000
R=int(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv)>2 else 2048
K=int(sys.argv[3]) if len(sys.argv)>3 else 8
cfg={'version':1,'idle_timeout':1000000000,'packet_limit':1000000000,'prefix_width':32,'rules':[{'id':i,'class':i%65536,'priority':0,'ranges':[[2048,2048]]*K} for i in range(R)],'fallback':{'class':0}}
t=time.monotonic(); p=subprocess.run(['python3','-I','/app/submission/main.py','compile'],input=json.dumps(cfg).encode(),stdout=subprocess.PIPE); print('compile',time.monotonic()-t,'size',len(p.stdout),'rc',p.returncode)
path='/workspace/tmp/program.json';open(path,'wb').write(p.stdout)
req=[{'op':'open','flow':0,'time':0}]
t=0
left=N
while left:
 q=min(1024,left);left-=q
 req.append({'op':'chunk','packets':[{'flow':0,'time':t,'source':0,'length':1} for _ in range(q)]})
req.append({'op':'close','flow':0,'time':t})
data=''.join(json.dumps(x,separators=(',',':'))+'\n' for x in req).encode();print('input size',len(data),'requests',len(req))
t=time.monotonic(); p=subprocess.run(['python3','-I','/app/submission/main.py','stream',path],input=data,stdout=subprocess.PIPE);print('stream',time.monotonic()-t,'out',len(p.stdout),'rc',p.returncode)
PY
python3 /workspace/tmp/stress.py 100000 2048 8
